text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Starting today, my trainee and I will be
taking on
the Twinkle Series. The
Umamusume joining me
for this journey
is none other than...

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: I'm Kitasan Black! Let's do our best!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
I want to be someone who brings
excitement to
everyone! Just like my
father!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
I'm going to do my best to barrel ahead
at full
speed, so train me up good and
encourage me to
the max!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
And so, <chrname> and I
take our
first steps towards competing in
the Twinkle
Series!
